fields.statement: QA at a2f3e32b with a binary built from the branch (go build -trimpath), in a scratch repo: an accepted change set 'Blocked' with question store-q (300-char statement) blocking capability store, and a plan change set 'Plan reports' with a run journal stopped at its gate on park-disk and park-format plus a journalled advisor recommendation on park-disk. rhiza inbox printed both gate questions' full statements with their handles, 'in plain words', 'blocks: Exports go to the store', the recommendation and reasons on park-disk, and the blocker's full 300-char statement with 'blocks: Kept store reachable (store)'. rhiza inbox --json gave questions[] with handle, statement, blocks, restatement, recommendation, reasons, and the blocker's blocks_title.

QA at a2f3e32b with a binary built from the branch (go build -trimpath), in a scratch repo: the inbox-question-advisor workflow (command step adds question gate-q and journals a session-less asked entry, then stops) run via rhiza run start --foreground with fake claude/rex on PATH. The run logged 'advisor session ... on question gate-q', the fake advisor got the template text in its prompt and ran rhiza run recommend; the journal got one advisor and one recommended entry with asker = the question node ID and restated text; rhiza inbox then showed 'in plain words: Where should exports be stored?', the recommendation and reasons, and the statement stayed the template text.

QA at a2f3e32b with a binary built from the branch (go build -trimpath), in a scratch repo: rhiza tui app inbox driven in tmux. The gate form for the two-question plan run showed '1 of 2: <restatement>', Blocks, Recommended, Why and '2 of 2: <statement>' above 'Your answer to question N of 2', no handles; typing two answers and submitting wrote decisions answer-park-disk (quote 'Use the SSD') and answer-park-format (quote 'JSON') to the right questions (resume then failed only because the fake journal's workflow is empty). But the blocker's answer form at 60/80/90/160 columns showed the 300-char question on ONE line cut at the pane edge, not wrapped, until the pane was resized; and the word 'store' (the handle of what it blocks) was replaced by '…' in the question and in 'Blocks: Kept … reachable'.

QA at a2f3e32b with a binary built from the branch (go build -trimpath), in a scratch repo: rhiza tui app inbox in tmux at 60-160 columns: the list rows are one line each, truncated with an ellipsis ('Which disk should hold the … when the machin…'), not wrapped, and do not say what they block; the blocker row and answer form show 'hold the … when' because scrub replaced the substring 'store' (the blocked capability's handle) inside the question's prose. The gate detail panel (after answering) wrapped and showed no handle or ID except 'next: rhiza run resume …'.
